query:
INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'the-glass-menagerie'
AND t.name IN ('Memory Play', 'Southern Gothic', '1930s');
